`generated-video.webm` is a synthetic 64 × 64 solid-color VP8 video recorded from a canvas with Chrome MediaRecorder on October 28, 2026. It contains no customer or third-party media. The producing browser decoded it successfully and reported 64 × 64 dimensions. Storage integration tests use its real encoded bytes, MIME type and SHA256 to verify retained playback after provider access is disabled. The smaller inline header fixtures in unit tests intentionally exercise signature and failure handling only.
